title: Practice: a prompt template builder, graded on structure (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 full prompt has every section in order
cases.says: A full spec renders every section in the order above

cases.id: e1 absent optional sections are omitted not empty
cases.says: Absent, empty and whitespace-only optional sections are omitted, not rendered empty

cases.id: e2 variables fill once and a missing one is named
cases.says: Variables are filled in one pass; a missing variable is named in the error
A missing, empty or whitespace-only task is refused

cases.id: e4 document text cannot close its own tag
cases.says: Document text and names are escaped, so a document cannot close its own tag

cases.id: e5 placeholders inside documents stay literal
cases.says: Placeholders inside document text stay literal

cases.id: e6 documents and examples keep their order and index
cases.says: Documents and examples keep their order and their numbering
